scenes.tts: Can three questions predict a Slit and Robo mutant? Is Slit there? Can the axon hear it? When does it start hearing it?
scenes.visual: Title card: Predicting Midline Mutants. The three questions on screen.
scenes.narration: Can three questions predict a Slit and Robo mutant? Is Slit there? Can the axon hear it? When does it start hearing it?

scenes.tts: Here is a ledger. Each row is a genotype. Read across before looking at the last column.
scenes.visual: An empty ledger table: genotype, Slit at the midline, hears before crossing, hears after crossing, prediction, observed.
scenes.narration: Here is a ledger. Each row is a genotype. Read across before looking at the last column.

scenes.tts: Wild type first. A commissural axon barely hears Slit before crossing, and hears it well after. It crosses once.
scenes.visual: Row fills: wild type commissural; Slit yes; hears weakly before crossing and strongly afterwards; crosses once.
scenes.narration: Wild type first. A commissural axon barely hears Slit before crossing, and hears it well after. It crosses once.

scenes.tts: An ipsilateral axon hears Slit from the start. It never crosses.
scenes.visual: Row fills: wild type ipsilateral; yes, yes, yes; never crosses.
scenes.narration: An ipsilateral axon hears Slit from the start. It never crosses.

scenes.tts: Try a row. A fly mutant for comm. Slit is there. When does the axon hear it?
scenes.visual: Row: fly comm. Slit column says yes; the others blank.
scenes.narration: Try a row. A fly mutant for comm. Slit is there. When does the axon hear it?

scenes.tts: Too early. It is repelled before crossing, and almost no rungs form.
scenes.visual: Row completes: too early; repelled before crossing; almost no rungs.
scenes.narration: Too early. It is repelled before crossing, and almost no rungs form.

scenes.tts: Next row. A fly lacking both robo and comm. Predict.
scenes.visual: Row: fly robo;comm, blank.
scenes.narration: Next row. A fly lacking both robo and comm. Predict.

scenes.tts: Like robo. Robo two is still there, so axons are pushed out, and some come back.
scenes.caption: Like robo. Robo2 is still there, so axons are pushed out, and some come back.
scenes.visual: Row completes: weakly (Robo2), weakly (Robo2); like robo.
scenes.narration: Like robo. Robo2 is still there, so axons are pushed out, and some come back.

scenes.tts: Now a fly making Comm in every neuron, at a modest level. Can the axon hear Slit after crossing?
scenes.visual: Row: modest Comm in every neuron, blank.
scenes.narration: Now a fly making Comm in every neuron, at a modest level. Can the axon hear Slit after crossing?

scenes.tts: Only weakly. Robo is kept low, so axons cross and may come back. The ladder looks like robo.
scenes.visual: Row completes: weakly, weakly; robo-like ladder.
scenes.narration: Only weakly. Robo is kept low, so axons cross and may come back. The ladder looks like robo.

scenes.tts: The mouse rows read the same way. With no Slits, there is no Slit push, so axons stall or recross.
scenes.visual: Row: mouse, no Slit1, Slit2, Slit3; no; may stall or recross; many stall, some recross.
scenes.narration: The mouse rows read the same way. With no Slits, there is no Slit push, so axons stall or recross.

scenes.tts: With no Robo three, axons hear too early, and almost none cross.
scenes.caption: With no Robo3, axons hear too early, and almost none cross.
scenes.visual: Row: mouse, no Robo3; too early; almost none cross.
scenes.narration: With no Robo3, axons hear too early, and almost none cross.

scenes.tts: The last row is where the rule fails. Remove Robo one, Robo two and Robo three together.
scenes.caption: The last row is where the rule fails. Remove Robo1, Robo2 and Robo3 together.
scenes.visual: Last row: mouse, no Robo1, Robo2, Robo3. Highlighted in a warning colour.
scenes.narration: The last row is where the rule fails. Remove Robo1, Robo2 and Robo3 together.

scenes.tts: The rule predicts that some crossing returns, because the receptors acting too early are gone.
scenes.visual: Prediction cell: some crossing returns; axons may then stall or recross.
scenes.narration: The rule predicts that some crossing returns, because the receptors acting too early are gone.

scenes.tts: In the spinal cord, crossing partly returns. In hindbrain precerebellar axons, it does not.
scenes.visual: Observed cell splits: spinal cord, partly; hindbrain precerebellar, no.
scenes.narration: In the spinal cord, crossing partly returns. In hindbrain precerebellar axons, it does not.

scenes.tts: So there, Robo three must do more than mute. It also strengthens netrin attraction, which removing Robo one and Robo two cannot replace.
scenes.caption: So there, Robo3 must do more than mute. It also strengthens netrin attraction, which removing Robo1 and Robo2 cannot replace.
scenes.visual: Robo3 beside DCC again, netrin pull arrow.
scenes.narration: So there, Robo3 must do more than mute. It also strengthens netrin attraction, which removing Robo1 and Robo2 cannot replace.

scenes.tts: That points to the rule's main limit: it covers repulsion only. After crossing, pull and push must tip toward leaving. How that happens is still being worked out.
scenes.visual: A crossed axon with a netrin pull arrow and a Slit push arrow; the balance tips toward leaving, with a question mark. Label: the rule covers repulsion only.
scenes.narration: That points to the rule's main limit: it covers repulsion only. After crossing, pull and push must tip toward leaving. How that happens is still being worked out.

scenes.tts: So what makes the crossing final? The neuron changes a receptor on its own growth cone, and keeps the change.
scenes.visual: The growth cone on the far side, receptors on, a lock icon on the growth cone.
scenes.narration: So what makes the crossing final? The neuron changes a receptor on its own growth cone, and keeps the change.

scenes.tts: In flies, the neuron stops making Comm. In mice, the form of Robo three that muted the others disappears.
scenes.caption: In flies, the neuron stops making Comm. In mice, the form of Robo3 that muted the others disappears.
scenes.visual: Split screen: fly, Comm switched off; mouse, Robo3.1 gone, Robo1 and Robo2 free.
scenes.narration: In flies, the neuron stops making Comm. In mice, the form of Robo3 that muted the others disappears.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: an axon pushed too hard too early never crosses. One pushed too weakly after crossing may stall, or cross again.
scenes.visual: The completed ledger, with the three questions above it.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: an axon pushed too hard too early never crosses. One pushed too weakly after crossing may stall, or cross again.
